definition: A place or organization that offers alternative dispute resolution opportunities is offering alternative dispute resolution services. These services are designed to resolve conflicts between parties without the need for potentially lengthy and expensive litigation. Examples of alternative dispute resolution services include mediation, arbitration, and negotiation. Many places that offer alternative dispute resolution also provide information to help potentially interested parties decide if alternative dispute resolution fits their needs better than a conventional trial would.
